bio.text: Anthony Forlini is the Republican candidate for Michigan Secretary of State in 2026, nominated at the party convention on August 22.
He was elected Macomb County Clerk in 2020, served in the Michigan House of Representatives (District 24) from 2011 to 2017, and was Harrison Township Supervisor from 2004 to 2010.
He earned a bachelor's degree from Western Michigan University in 1984 and has worked as a Certified Financial Planner.
